routes.name: Gonzaga University, Spokane -> Manito Park, Spokane
routes.note: Urban Spokane, which no round has audited inside the city. Crosses the Spokane River and climbs the South Hill; tests whether the router finds the signed river crossings and how it prices the bluff.

routes.name: Eastern Washington University, Cheney -> Riverfront Park, Spokane
routes.note: The real student commute into Spokane. The Fish Lake Trail parallels the direct SR 904 / I-90 corridor for much of it, so this is a trail-credit-versus-distance test on a 20 km crow.

routes.name: Howard Amon Park, Richland -> Sacajawea State Park, Pasco
routes.note: Tri-Cities on new endpoints: a park at the Snake/Columbia confluence reachable only across the river bridges. Round 2's Tri-Cities trip and round 5's Richland to Pasco both stayed inside the urban core.

routes.name: Western Washington University, Bellingham -> Birch Bay State Park
routes.note: North Whatcom County rural ground no round has touched. Tests the choice between the Blaine Road farm grid and the I-5 frontage corridor.

routes.name: Port Angeles waterfront -> Hurricane Ridge Visitor Center
routes.note: A single-road 1,500 m climb on Hurricane Ridge Road. Chosen to exercise the v.771 quadratic climb ramp where there is no alternative corridor to price against.

routes.name: Memorial Park, Wenatchee -> Riverwalk Park, Chelan
routes.note: Long inter-city rural: US 97A up the west bank of the Columbia, with US 2/97 on the east bank as the only alternative. A corridor choice between two state highways.

routes.name: White Salmon -> Columbia Gorge Interpretive Center, Stevenson
routes.note: The Washington side of the Gorge; every earlier Gorge finding was about the Oregon side. SR 14 has tunnels and long no-shoulder stretches, and the question is whether the router has anything else to offer.

routes.name: Downtown Yakima -> Selah Civic Center
routes.note: Short suburban trip across the Naches River. The Yakima Greenway runs most of the way and SR 823 is the direct road, so this is the trail-versus-arterial trade on a 7 km crow.
